name: pro-testing
description: The Verify phase: Vitest, agent-browser (interactive verification), Storybook interactions, plus a vendored qa-skills library (43 skills) exposed as a curated testing-core subset — qa-do/qa-start routers, playwright-automation, visual-testing, api/contract-testing, test-reliability, and QA strategy/risk/planning.
